name: get_ability
description: Continues from the reach_ruins save (player on the ruins floor to the left of the low platform). Runs right at full speed and jumps once: the arc clears the platform's left edge and lands on top, then walks right over the double-jump pickup. The pickup is only reachable by an actual jump, because the platform top is 110 px above the floor and a single jump rises about 136 px.
